content: CBA 2009 (Act 701) Part VII Chapter 1 supplies the parent statute for the BNM Shariah Advisory Council's role in Islamic financial business: s.56 (court/arbitrator must consider published SAC rulings or refer a Shariah question to the SAC), s.57 (SAC rulings on such a reference are binding on Islamic financial institutions under s.55 and on the referring court or arbitrator), and s.58 (an SAC ruling prevails over a conflicting ruling of an institution's internal Shariah body or committee). This is the statutory backbone of IFSA 2013 s.28(2) (compliance with an SAC ruling is deemed compliance with Shariah). Official English text is authoritative. Collection record 2026-09-14; AGC reprint as at 1 November 2020, pp.63–64. ss.56–58 have not been amended since 2009.
rule_subject: SAC 提交、拘束力与优先地位（CBA 链条总述）
national_transformation: CBA 2009 ss.56–58 与 IFSA 2013 s.28(2) 咬合：提交/考虑 → 拘束 → 优先。SAC 由 s.51 设立。

content:
Reference to Shariah Advisory Council for ruling from court or arbitrator.

56. (1) Where in any proceedings relating to Islamic financial business before any court or arbitrator any question arises concerning a Shariah matter, the court or the arbitrator, as the case may be, shall— (a) take into consideration any published rulings of the Shariah Advisory Council; or (b) refer such question to the Shariah Advisory Council for its ruling.

(2) Any request for advice or a ruling of the Shariah Advisory Council under this Act or any other law shall be submitted to the secretariat.

Source: Laws of Malaysia Act 701, AGC reprint as at 1 November 2020, p.63. Part VII, Chapter 1. Official English is authoritative. Not amended since 2009.

content:
Effect of Shariah rulings.

57. Any ruling made by the Shariah Advisory Council pursuant to a reference made under this Part shall be binding on the Islamic financial institutions under section 55 and the court or arbitrator making a reference under section 56.

Source: Laws of Malaysia Act 701, AGC reprint as at 1 November 2020, p.63. Official English is authoritative. Not amended since 2009.

content:
Shariah Advisory Council ruling prevails.

58. Where the ruling given by a Shariah body or committee constituted in Malaysia by an Islamic financial institution is different from the ruling given by the Shariah Advisory Council, the ruling of the Shariah Advisory Council shall prevail.

Source: Laws of Malaysia Act 701, AGC reprint as at 1 November 2020, p.64. Official English is authoritative. Not amended since 2009.
